codespaces.rationale: FR-4 (GitNexus install dry-run) is owned by design-codespaces; the CC layer's mechanisms (FR-1/2/3) do not require FR-4 to ship but share the FR-6 actionable-diagnostic contract. The CC layer's diagnostic shape is JSON-direct-to-stdout; the Codespaces layer's diagnostic shape is the existing log_mcp_event helper plus [postCreate] stderr echo. The composer audits FR-6 cross-cutting consistency.
shared_artifacts: .mcp.json (read-only consumed by OP-11 / FR-3; written by no CC-layer mechanism)

cicd.rationale: FR-5 (CI claude mcp list smoke) is owned by design-cicd. The CC layer's OP-11 rule (FR-3) is invocable from any python3 context, so the CI workflow MAY ALSO invoke it at PR time in addition to the Gate-6 invocation. That is design-cicd's call. The CC layer commits to OP-11 being a no-extra-setup invocation.
shared_artifacts: .mcp.json (read-only consumed by both FR-3 OP-11 and FR-5 connectivity smoke)
adrs/ADR-0041-install-mechanism-hybrid.md (FR-3 reads its invocation table; FR-5 may optionally cross-check)

cicd.what: OP-11 audit rule (audit_op11_adr_parity.py) is python3-invocable from the FR-5 CI workflow's runner if design-cicd wants to layer the parity check at PR time in addition to the Gate-6 invocation. The OP-11 rule is self-contained: it takes one positional argument (.mcp.json path) and reads ADR-0041 at a project-root-relative path. No new environment variables, no new credentials.

interface.stdout_shape: JSON {rule, name, target, findings[], servers_checked, adr_servers_recognized, deprecated_rows_skipped}

design-realization-audit-dimension.what: The OP-11 rule is the first OP rule that consumes a markdown ADR (rather than .mcp.json alone). A future feature that lifts the broader design-realization audit dimension (currently in the PRD's Won't-Have list) can either reuse OP-11's inline ADR-table parser or refactor it out to auditing-shared/. Q-CC-3 surfaces this decision.

verdict-parity-broader-severity-set.what: The FR-1 validator's blocking-severity set is {BLOCKER} only (per D-0001). A future feature can widen to {BLOCKER, MAJOR} if the strictness-over-ergonomics tiebreaker calls for it — the validator's per-agent contract table is the single edit point.

decisions_resolved.U-1: FR-1 blocking-severity set = {BLOCKER} only. Execution site = out-of-agent validator. (D-0001)
decisions_resolved.U-2: FR-2 self-check lives in orchestrator-internal logic at orchestrator entry (refined: immediately after Stage 1 completes — see Q-CC-6 for D-0003 refinement note). scope_class read hoisted from line 350 to post-Stage-1. checkpoint.execution_mode introduced as a first-class documented field (NEW schema surface, not a rename), with parent-driven-workaround canonicalized as the named single-agent-fallback config surface. (D-0003, refined)
decisions_resolved.U-3: FR-3 comparison algorithm = canonicalize whitespace + opaque ${VAR} tokens + string-equal. Deprecated-row handling = in-rule [DEPRECATED] marker on ADR-0041 row 71. (D-0004, D-0005)
decisions_resolved.U-7: FR-7 update lives in the deliverable archive commit (recommended; defer to composer per D-0009).
decisions_resolved.U-8 (NFR-1, NFR-2 portion): Concrete latency thresholds set: NFR-1 verdict-parity validator p95 ≤ 250 ms; NFR-2 dispatch self-check p95 ≤ 100 ms; OP-11 audit rule p95 ≤ 300 ms total. Methodology documented in cc-design.md against the existing OP-1 / checkpoint-write latency floor.

decisions_deferred_to_composer.D-0008 (PR shape): Recommended: single bundled PR. The CC layer's mechanisms (FR-1/2/3/7) all touch recipe-feature-pipeline/SKILL.md or its adjacent skills, so they are tightly coupled at the implementation surface. Flagged for user confirmation per synthesis. (Q-CC-4)
decisions_deferred_to_composer.D-0009 (deferral-register placement): Recommended: deliverable archive commit. Pure process judgment per synthesis. (Q-CC-5)

open_items.description: The exact SKILL.md diff for FR-1 wire-in (9 distinct invocation sites across the 5 reviewer-shaped agents in scope per D-0002: 5 shared-document-reviewer points + Stage 8 architecture-auditor + Stage 11 cross-artifact-auditor + T7 phase-quality-reviewer + T2 execute-task-quality-handler) is mechanical but voluminous; the Plan author owns the exact line edits. This design specifies the intent, not the line numbers.

OP-11's dependency on ADR-0041 table format stability is a known refactor-watch item. Recommend a tiny fixture-driven smoke test under .claude/skills/auditing-mcp/tests/op11_smoke/ so a future ADR table-format change is caught at audit time.
Composer should CoVe-check that no other ADR contradicts the parent-driven-workaround naming canonicalization (per D-0003 risks-accepted).
Cosmetic Stage-12-vs-Stage-13 drift in SKILL.md is acknowledged but explicitly excluded from this carve-out. Track as future housekeeping.

After FR-1 lands, recipe-feature-pipeline SKILL.md's 'shared-document-reviewer Invocation Points' table should be augmented with a footnote noting the verdict-parity validator runs after each invocation. Plan author owns placement.
